summary: Two suspicious iia values: area=2663 ha and production=2873.5 t are implausibly low; a third value of 2460450 t is implausibly high. The low values likely reflect a Chinese unit (thousand piculs/shi) mis-labeled as ha/tonnes in layer_b consolidation. The 2460450 t value is characteristic of 1930s iia data (IIA 1934-1938 averages: 2.32-2.71 Mt) and is either a temporally misassigned 1930s row or a unit-mismatch between an old iia pub (1000 quintals) and a newer pub (metric tonnes). Historical range for China groundnut production ca. 1909-1913 was likely 50k-200k t (Mitchell shows 404k t by 1922; iia export figures exceed 52k t in 1909-1913 average). Audit required: (1) trace raw source document for 2460450 t value; (2) verify unit column for 2873.5 t and 2663 ha in older iia pub; (3) flag both observations as unit-unverified and exclude from production aggregation until resolved. Polity CHN-1895-1913 itself is correct (CShapes 2.0 feature 710 vintage 1899).

summary: Confirmed data ingestion error in data/external/before_1961.csv for China mainland goats sourced from mitchell/page251-300.xlsx sheet page_41_table_1. Root cause: the import script applied a wrong unit multiplier to the raw Excel values (which are in thousands, unit column B=1000), yielding values ~1001x too large for 1950-1960 and ~2x too large for 1945-1947. Specifically: the reviewed Excel has raw values like 1821 (1950) in column J; these should be multiplied by 1000 to get heads (1821000 goats in 1950), but stored values are e.g. 1822821000 = 1821 * 1001 * 1000. For 1945-1947 the Excel goats values (13249 13609 13976) are stored as 26498000 / 27218000 / 27952000 = exactly 2000x each raw value instead of 1000x. The 1949 cell J7 is a text annotation '16130 millions'; the import parsed the numeric part 16130 and stored 16146130 which is only 0.1% above the correct ~16130000 and is plausible. No territorial or polity-boundary action needed. Action required: fix the import pipeline to apply unit multiplier x1000 only (not x1001000) for China mainland goats rows from page_41_table_1 then regenerate before_1961.csv and re-run the flag pipeline. The corrected 1950 value should be 1821000 heads (not 1.82 billion); 1950-1960 series should all be divided by 1001; 1945-1947 series should be divided by 2.
